name: Kiriya Kurenai
source:
[i]The proud fifth daughter[/i]

Although she has a friendly and cheerful personality, she is proud of her membership in the noble Kiritani family, and wishes to act accordingly like an aristocratic lady. This can also lead to her being a bit stubborn, and she can easily get angry if teased.

She also tends to expect the same ideal from others, and dislikes sloppy and unrefined behavior and speech.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
